en.headline: Civil Service Bureau offers priority hiring for affected Hongkong Post staff
en.dek: The Federation of Trade Unions said the arrangements include preferential selection for transfers and relaxed education requirements for clerical grades.
body: The Civil Service Bureau will give priority consideration to about 200 Hongkong Post staff affected by the shift to two-year contracts when they apply for other civil service posts, according to the Federation of Trade Unions.

The union said on Tuesday that if an affected staff member scores the same as another candidate in an assessment, the affected worker will be preferred. For transfers to Assistant Clerical Officer or Clerical Assistant grades, education requirements will also be relaxed.

Hongkong Post earlier said staff completing probation from September would not receive permanent terms and would instead be offered two-year civil service contracts. The bureau had previously indicated it was studying preferential arrangements.

zh.headline: 公務員事務局為受影響香港郵政員工轉職提供優先聘用
zh.dek: 工聯會引述安排，受影響員工轉任其他職系可獲優先選拔，轉任助理文書主任等職系可放寬學歷要求。
body: 工聯會周二表示，公務員事務局已為約200名受香港郵政改合約制影響的員工，提供轉任其他公務員職位的優先考慮。
工聯會指，若受影響員工在考核中與其他考生分數相同，會優先取錄受影響員工。轉任助理文書主任或文書助理職系時，學歷要求亦可放寬。
香港郵政早前宣布，由9月起完成試用期的人員不獲長期聘用，改以兩年公務員合約續聘。公務員事務局此前已表示正研究優先安排。
